name: plan-steps
description: Shows the plan's steps when there is one (task list, approved plan or plan file): the /steps panel and a quiet line under the chat; keeps an open plan when the chat is cleared (/clear) or summarized (compact), and asks before an answer leaves steps open

holdFinish.title: Hold the finish
holdFinish.description: When an answer leaves plan steps open, ask Claude to go on by itself (at most twice in a row without a finished step) before showing the card
